brief: Sponsor Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical. List its stopped (terminated, withdrawn or suspended) trials in the snapshot with phase, status, stated reason and whether results were posted.

findings.claim: NCT02618915 is a Phase 1/Phase 2 terminated trial with stated why_stopped "Sponsor decision; not due to any safety concerns related to DTX101." (category business/strategic), and results were posted.
NCT02736188 is a Phase 3 terminated trial with a blank why_stopped category, and results were posted.
NCT02731690 is a Phase 2 terminated trial with a blank why_stopped category, and results were posted.
NCT03216486 is a Phase 2 withdrawn trial with stated why_stopped "Administrative Reason" (category business/strategic), and results were not posted.
NCT02960217 is a Phase 3 terminated trial with stated why_stopped "Study was halted prematurely due to lack of efficacy." (category efficacy), and results were posted.
NCT02599961 is a Phase 2 terminated trial with stated why_stopped "Study was halted prematurely due to lack of efficacy" (category efficacy), and results were posted.

NCT04088734 is a Phase 1/Phase 2 terminated trial with stated why_stopped "Terminated due to lack of efficacy seen in patients with advanced MPS IIIA disease. The patients will be followed up annually for safety until five years post dosing" (category safety), and results were posted.
NCT05312697 is a Phase 2 terminated trial with stated why_stopped "Sponsor decision not related to safety concerns" (category business/strategic), and results were posted.
NCT04990388 is a Phase 1/Phase 2 terminated trial with stated why_stopped "Sponsor decision not related to safety concerns" (category business/strategic), and results were posted.

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.sponsor ILIKE '%Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical%' AND d.stopped ORDER BY t.primary_completion_date
